contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return max(used - limit, 0). Being exactly at the limit or below it produces zero.
contract.domain: Numeric arguments are finite, between -1000 and 1000, with no negative-zero inputs. Inputs are unchanged. Used and limit are nonnegative.
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
